about.label: About me
about.intro: I'm Amirali, a UI/UX designer who turns messy problems into clear, calm and useful digital products. I care about the details people feel but rarely notice.
points: Research-led, from interviews to usability tests
Design systems that scale with the product
headline: Designer by craft
Problem solver by nature

facts.title: Experience
facts.text: Years of designing websites, mobile apps and dashboards for startups and growing teams.

facts.title: End-to-end process
facts.text: From discovery and user research to wireframes, prototypes and the final polished interface.

facts.title: Tools I use
facts.text: Figma, FigJam, Framer, Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, Protopie and a lot of paper sketches.

facts.title: How I work
facts.text: Clear communication, short feedback loops and decisions backed by users, not guesses.
